$comment: Files that reach a database pool WITHOUT entering withTenantDb — checked by
This list is a RATCHET seeded from the state at audit PA-1 (2026-09-04). It
may only shrink. A new bypass that is not listed fails the build; a listed
file that no longer bypasses ALSO fails the build, so fixing a file forces
the entry to be deleted and the list can never rot.
class = by-design: there is genuinely no tenant to scope to (pre-tenant token
paths, identity, public/unauthenticated reads, person-scoped data, tables
with no org_id, cross-tenant platform administration). These stay.
class = debt: this SHOULD run inside withTenantDb. Tracked by PA-1R Phase 3.4.
Every one of these is a place where a single missing WHERE clause is a
cross-tenant leak with no second line of defence.
class = defect: a known bug being fixed in PA-1R Phase 2. Should reach zero

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/delivery-s.reason: FIXED (PA-1R 2.1). The finops write now runs inside withTenantDb on the app role, and the suppression on the app pool. The remaining system-pool use is ONE id→org lookup that opens that boundary — the dispatch's org is the only thing that can, and reading it is itself org-scoped. Adapter-verified id, single column, no write.

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/sms-inboun.reason: FIXED (PA-1R 2.1). Writes `suppressions` on the app pool, which holds the DML. The table is deliberately not org-scoped — a person texting STOP tells the platform, not one club — so it carries no org_id and no RLS, and there is no tenant boundary to enter.

apps/web/src/app/api/webhooks/razorpay/r.reason: PA-1 §10 P0-1 — loads the payment on the raw app pool with no app.org_id, so FORCE RLS returns zero rows and every capture 404s under the production roles. PA-1R Phase 2.2.

apps/web/src/app/readyz/route.ts.reason: Readiness probe: `select 1` only. Touches no tenant data, and must answer even when no session or org exists.

apps/web/src/app/demo/[token]/invite.ics.reason: Pre-tenant token path. The demo tables carry no org_id and no RLS — the person holding the link is a stranger with no tenant to be scoped to.

apps/web/src/app/schedule-demo/pick/page.reason: Public booking form, no session. Demo scheduling tables have no org_id.

apps/web/src/app/dev/inbox/page.tsx.reason: Dev-only surface (notFound() outside development). Reads the OTP inbox, which is identity data with no tenant.

apps/web/src/app/inbox/page.tsx.reason: Person-scoped inbox spanning every org the viewer belongs to. The tenant here is the person, not one organization.

apps/web/src/server/auth/actions.ts.reason: Identity: people, sessions, otp_codes, passkeys. None carries org_id, none has RLS, and at login there is no tenant yet — this is the boundary that establishes one.

apps/web/src/server/player/profile.ts.reason: player_profiles is person-scoped with no org_id; the module self-scopes by personId.

apps/web/src/server/player/career.ts.reason: A player's career spans organizations by definition; scoping it to one would be wrong.

apps/web/src/server/messaging/actions.ts.reason: notification_preferences is person-scoped with no org_id — deliberately a table a club can neither read nor write.

apps/web/src/server/financial-operations.reason: An owner's own receipts across every org they have ever bid in — person-scoped by paddle, cross-org by intent.

apps/web/src/server/competition/public.t.reason: Public directory and season pages for unauthenticated visitors. Gated on visibility, not on tenancy.

apps/web/src/server/competition/posters..reason: Public share-card rendering for visibility-gated competitions; no session exists.

apps/web/src/server/competition/pass.ts.reason: Entitlement/tier lookup is a platform-billing fact that crosses orgs.

apps/web/src/server/feature-settings.ts.reason: Platform-scope feature rows have no org_id; the org and auction layers below them do run inside a tenant boundary.

apps/web/src/server/settlement/coordinat.reason: System sweep: enumerates orgs on the system pool, then enters withTenantDb per org to do the actual work.

apps/web/src/server/admin/actions.ts.reason: Platform administration — cross-tenant by definition, read-only, gated by the platform:admin capability which RLS makes unforgeable.

apps/web/src/server/admin/access-log.ts.reason: Writes the audited breadcrumb for a platform-admin read. Cross-tenant by definition.

apps/web/src/server/admin/demo-views.ts.reason: Platform demo desk. Demo tables have no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/admin/pass-views.ts.reason: Platform billing projections, cross-tenant by definition.

apps/web/src/server/admin/pass-actions.t.reason: Platform billing: resolves a tier change for any org, gated by platform:billing.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/actions.ts.reason: Public newsletter + demo request from strangers. No tenant exists.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/booking-ac.reason: Demo booking by HMAC-derived token, pre-tenant.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-avail.reason: Public demo availability; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-booki.reason: Public demo booking; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-desk..reason: Demo desk reads; tables carry no org_id.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-remin.reason: Scheduled reminder sweep over pre-tenant demo bookings.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-reten.reason: Retention purge over pre-tenant demo data.

apps/web/src/server/marketing/demo-slots.reason: Slot computation over pre-tenant demo data.

apps/web/src/server/orgs/actions.ts.reason: Invite preview and accept are THE documented pre-tenant token paths the system pool exists for: the reader is not yet a member, so no tenant can be established. NOTE: the accept path is separately tracked for transaction atomicity (PA-1 §9, PA-1R Phase 5.6).

apps/web/src/server/auction/owner-action.reason: Owner-join landing and accept by token — pre-tenant, the same class as invites.

apps/web/src/server/home/dashboard.ts.reason: PA-1 §10 P1-4 (priority) — money aggregates for every competition the viewer belongs to, on the bypass pool. Membership is already proven before these run, so a tenant boundary per org is available. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/auction/conduct-acti.reason: PA-1 §10 P1-4 (priority) — reads lots and owner phone numbers for the conduct screen on the bypass pool. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/auction/actions.ts.reason: auctionReadiness is read on the system pool after the capability gate has already resolved the org. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/auction/live-actions.reason: One system-pool read inside an otherwise tenant-scoped module. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/competition/actions..reason: resolveCompetition and several season reads run on the system pool after membership is proven. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/competition/fixture-.reason: Organizer schedule reads on the system pool after membership is proven. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/competition/tourname.reason: Tournament listings on the system pool after membership is re-proven in application code. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/settlement/actions.t.reason: resolveCompetition runs on the system pool before the tenant transaction opens; the money commands themselves are correctly inside withTenantDb. PA-1R Phase 3.4.

apps/web/src/server/media/actions.ts.reason: Media subject resolution partly on the system pool; the writes are inside a tenant boundary. PA-1R Phase 3.4.
